{{Quote|I'm the only person in Khomm's recent memory who has done anything... unpredictable.|[[Dorsk 81]]|<ref name="Darksaber (novel)">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>}}
The '''Khommites''' were a [[Near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] hailing from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Khomm/Legends|Khomm]]. Circa [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] the Khommite people achieved a level of [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] technology far surpassing that of the rest of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Believing that their society had achieved perfection, the people of Khomm began the cloning of "perfect" individuals, allowing their society to remain unchanged for the next millennium. Khommites' digestive systems were so specified that they could only eat processed food wafers.
[[File:Dorsk82.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Dorsk 82]]]]
Viewing [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] as an undesirable fluke, the Khommites endeavored to remove the trait from their species. Despite this fact the trait would occasionally surface, as in the case of [[Dorsk 81]], a Khommite [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].

The Khommites were rigidly conformist in their views, and saw any disruption of the status quo as a threat to their way of life.

In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] ordered an [[Attack on Khomm|attack]] on Khomm, when it was discovered that the Jedi Dorsk 81 and [[Kyp Durron]] had visited the planet. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Ivan Cronus|Cronus]] carried out the order with [[Crimson Command]], devastating the planet and its population, forcing the Khommites to do something they had not done in centuries&mdash;adapt.

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']], the Khommites are described as genderless and having forsaken gender when they began cloning. However, individual Khommites are consistently referred to as "he."
